figures.title: US pending home sales hit a nearly 12-year low in September
figures.analysis: The image is one orange line chart from Redfin. The title says US seasonally adjusted pending home sales in September 2026 fell to a nearly 12-year low. The vertical axis is thousands of units from 250 to 500. The horizontal axis runs from 2012 through 2026. The series rises from 2012 into 2020, drops sharply to about 300 in April 2020, rebounds above 450 in 2021, then trends down through 2026. The latest point for September 2026 is labeled 316652. A callout marks April 2020 at 299829. The source line names Redfin.

marketTone: November WTI settled at 93.74 and December Brent at 106.65 while empty supertankers avoided the Persian Gulf. The S&P 500 slipped to 7807.24 and the Nasdaq fell to 27245.90 ahead of bank earnings. Hammack said inflation needs faster small rate moves. The chart is US pending home sales at 316652 in September 2026.

summary.text: 第一财经: the Dow rose 0.38% to 51850.55, the S&P 500 fell 0.06% to 7807.24, and the Nasdaq fell 0.44% to 27245.90.
华尔街见闻: November WTI rose 2.06% to 93.74 dollars a barrel and December Brent rose 1.84% to 106.65 dollars, both at two-week highs. COMEX gold fell 0.48% to 4195.9 dollars an ounce.

华尔街见闻: Cleveland Fed president Hammack said policy should move in smaller steps more often to keep inflation expectations anchored. Columbus Day left the cash Treasury market closed while 10-year futures implied about 5.24%.
第一财经: Meta rose more than 3% after Muse Wonder launched. The Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 2.7%. The Golden Dragon index fell 0.38%.
财新: from 1 April 2027 the VAT export rebate on new-energy vehicles falls from 13% to 9%. 华尔街见闻: the commerce ministry said the EU hybrid-car deal does not target China alone.

signal: November WTI rose to 93.74 while at least ten empty supertankers avoided the Persian Gulf. The Nasdaq fell to 27245.90 and the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 2.7%. Hammack pressed for faster small rate moves against inflation. September pending home sales on the chart hit 316652, near the April 2020 low of 299829.

themeCards.title: Empty supertankers are turning away from the Gulf
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：沙特面临新一轮无人机和巡航导弹袭击，至少十艘空载超级油轮避开波斯湾航线。 华尔街见闻：11月WTI涨2.06%至93.74美元/桶，12月布伦特涨1.84%至106.65美元/桶，收于两周高位；前一周WTI结算价为91.85美元/桶。
themeCards.mechanism: When empty VLCCs skip the Gulf, export schedules lose slack and buyers pay up on supply fear before barrels are missed. CICC (21 September): with stocks already low, each Hormuz headline adds more premium than the same news would have last spring. Oil carries the 93.74 WTI and 106.65 Brent closes on the tape. The theme changes if Gulf tanker traffic normalizes while WTI falls back under 91.85.
themeCards.trigger: WTI holding above 91.85 while tankers still avoid the Gulf.
themeCards.invalidator: WTI falling back under 91.85 with Gulf traffic recovering.

themeCards.title: Washington says both sides broke the energy truce
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：特朗普称俄乌双方均违反能源停火安排。泽连斯基指责莫斯科违反安排并称将继续远程打击，特朗普要求双方共同结束战争。
themeCards.mechanism: A truce that both capitals deny means energy infrastructure stays in the crosshairs, so diesel and crude risk premia can move together even when spot demand is soft. 财经早茶 (13 October): Trump said both sides violated the energy ceasefire and must work together to end the war. Oil carries the supply-risk bid tied to those strikes. The theme changes if verified pauses on energy targets hold for a full week.
themeCards.trigger: Continued strikes on energy assets after the announced truce.
themeCards.invalidator: A verified week without new energy-facility strikes.

themeCards.title: Hammack wants faster small moves against inflation
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：克利夫兰联储行长主张对货币政策小步快调，以保持通胀预期稳定。 华尔街见闻：哈玛克称通胀压力已不局限于能源，关税与AI基建需求也在推升成本；哥伦布日现金债市休市，10年期国债期货隐含收益率约5.24%。
themeCards.mechanism: When a 2026 voter Hammack argues for quicker small hikes, front-end yields can reprice even on a bond holiday. 财经早茶 (13 October): she warned that waiting too long forces larger corrections later. USTs carry the 5.24% futures-implied 10-year yield on the tape. The theme changes if the next core CPI print cools enough to cut the hike odds materially.
themeCards.trigger: Futures-implied 10-year yields staying near 5.24% after hawkish Fed talk.
themeCards.invalidator: A core CPI miss that pulls hike odds down sharply.

themeCards.title: The Philadelphia semiconductor index kept falling
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：费城半导体指数录得7月以来最长连跌。第一财经：费城半导体指数收跌2.7%，盘中触及三周低点，ARM跌4.15%，闪迪跌近6%。 华尔街见闻：纳指跌0.44%至27245.90点。
themeCards.mechanism: The longest Philadelphia semiconductor losing streak since July shows AI hardware is trading as rate-sensitive growth again rather than a one-directional bid. 财经早茶 (13 October): the streak is the longest since July. The Nasdaq carries the 27245.90 close while semis lead the drop. The theme changes if the Philadelphia index posts two up days in a row.
themeCards.trigger: The Philadelphia semiconductor index extending its losing streak.
themeCards.invalidator: Two consecutive up sessions in the Philadelphia semiconductor index.

themeCards.title: Meta is selling Muse Wonder as a paid agent
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：Meta发布Muse Wonder，高管称其性能跻身业界前沿，用户需订阅每月20美元或100美元服务，扎克伯格暗示将进一步增加支出。 第一财经：Meta推出新模型后股价大涨超3%。
themeCards.mechanism: A subscription agent at 20 or 100 dollars a month is Meta's attempt to monetize AI off advertising alone. CICC (21 September): Muse is the consumer-agent path Meta is betting on after Llama setbacks. The Nasdaq carries Meta's outperformance against a down tape. The theme changes if paid Muse uptake stalls while capex guidance still rises.
themeCards.trigger: Meta stock outperforming while Muse stays subscription-only.
themeCards.invalidator: Meta guiding lower AI spend while Muse paid uptake stays weak.

themeCards.title: Pending home sales fell to a 12-year low
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：美国9月二手房签约量创近十二年最低，房贷利率飙升重挫购房需求。 华尔街见闻：Redfin季调数据显示9月待售签约量316652套，2014年以来最低，30年期抵押贷款利率10月8日升至7.4%。
themeCards.mechanism: Pending sales at 316652 show 7.4% mortgage rates are freezing turnover, not just slowing it. 财经早茶 (13 October): the mail ties the collapse to the rate spike. Long-end Treasury demand can improve if housing weakens enough to cap inflation, but only if labor does not re-accelerate. The theme changes if pending sales rebound while rates stay above 7%.
themeCards.trigger: Pending sales holding near 316652 with mortgage rates above 7%.
themeCards.invalidator: Pending sales rebounding two months in a row below 7% mortgage rates.

themeCards.title: Beijing is cutting NEV export rebates from 2027
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：中国自2027年4月1日起将新能源汽车增值税出口退税率由13%下调至9%。 华尔街见闻：9月新能源乘用车出口55.8万辆，同比增长163.5%。
themeCards.mechanism: Cutting the rebate to 9% from 13% tells exporters to front-load shipments before April 2027 and rebuild margins after. 财新 (13 October): the policy keeps fuel vehicles at 13% while NEV loses four points. China ADRs and auto exporters carry the margin squeeze ahead of the date. The theme changes if Beijing delays the April 2027 start.
themeCards.trigger: The 9% rebate rate staying scheduled for April 2027.
themeCards.invalidator: A official delay or smaller cut than 13% to 9%.

themeCards.title: LVMH fashion sales missed as China stayed weak
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：LVMH时装和皮具部门季度营收弱于预期，路易威登在华受消费者抵制。 华尔街见闻：三季度时装与皮具有机销售下滑5%，为预期降幅1.6%的三倍多。
themeCards.mechanism: A 5% organic drop in fashion and leather means China luxury demand is still a drag rather than a reopening narrative. 财经早茶 (13 October): Louis Vuitton faced consumer pushback in China. Luxury-linked China ADRs carry that earnings gap. The theme changes if the next quarter shows fashion organic sales back above zero.
themeCards.trigger: Fashion and leather organic sales staying negative.
themeCards.invalidator: Fashion and leather organic sales turning positive next quarter.

themeCards.title: US bitcoin demand stayed soft on Coinbase
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：比特币报81894.84美元，跌1.3%。律动：Coinbase比特币溢价指数连续20日为负，暂报-0.1398%。
themeCards.mechanism: A negative Coinbase premium for 20 days means US buyers are not leading the tape even when headline prices hold. 律动 (13 October): the reading near -0.1398% is a recent low. Bitcoin carries the soft US bid alongside the 81894.84 desk quote. The theme changes if the premium turns positive for a week.
themeCards.trigger: Coinbase premium staying negative for 20 consecutive days.
themeCards.invalidator: Coinbase premium turning positive for seven straight days.

themeCards.title: Kazakhstan is selling gold as yields rise
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶：哈萨克斯坦开始出售黄金储备，因美债收益率上涨增强美元吸引力。 华尔街见闻：哈央行计划年底前将黄金占外汇储备比重降低约3个百分点至75%左右。
themeCards.mechanism: When a large official buyer switches to selling into 5% Treasury yields, gold loses a steady bid that mattered on the way up. CICC (8 June): central-bank buying has slowed broadly, so Kazakhstan's sale fits a wider pause. Gold carries the policy shift away from accumulation. The theme changes if Kazakhstan stops selling before reaching the 75% target.
themeCards.trigger: Gold share of reserves heading toward 75% while yields stay elevated.
themeCards.invalidator: Kazakhstan pausing sales above 78% of reserves in gold.

globalImplies.text: If WTI holds above 91.85 while tankers avoid the Gulf, crude and product markets are still pricing route risk, not just demand.
If Hammack's hawkish line lands while the dollar index sits at a three-month high, front-end rates can move even when cash Treasuries are closed.
If pending sales stay near 316652 while mortgage rates stay above 7%, housing is a drag on consumption that CPI may later reflect.

globalTensions: The mail put WTI up on Gulf risks while the Nasdaq and Philadelphia semiconductor index fell. Hammack pressed for tighter policy while Columbus Day closed cash Treasuries. Meta rose on Muse Wonder while Broadcom warned on AI capital. Kazakhstan sold gold as COMEX gold fell to 4195.9. China cut future NEV export rebates while September exports rose 163.5%.
chinaStance: Beijing cut the NEV export VAT rebate to 9% from April 2027 and told Brussels the hybrid-car deal does not target China alone. Tencent is raising bonds for AI capex and DeepSeek is leading Winverse AI. LVMH fashion sales missed on China weakness. Hong Kong tightened IPO oversight while launching new tech indices with HKEX and S&P Dow Jones.

chinaImplies.text: If the hybrid-car deal holds while the NEV rebate falls to 9%, exporters will front-load Europe and emerging markets before April 2027.
If LVMH fashion organic sales stay down 5%, China luxury demand is still a headwind for European earners with large Asia exposure.
If Tencent bonds fund AI capex while Hong Kong tightens IPO oversight, onshore tech funding and offshore listing rules are moving in opposite directions.
